    return fyne.AppMetadata{
        ID:      "testApp",
        Name:    "Test App", 
        Version: "1.0.0",
        Build:   1,
    }
}
```

Run `go build theme/json.go` to verify the fixes work before continuing. These compilation errors will block any testing.
